Name: Kairos Karius Bekarys Bontell

Voice: British accent, well spoken, fancy words, "If you could comprehend my anger, you would not be trying to stop me."

Description: human male, 5'10, blonde hair with slight curls, piercing ice blue eyes, glasses, black and white wizard robes with a fine white fur collar, face always in a slight scowl

Important Info: The Rogue Timekeeper, the false god Vaior. Has been pretending to be Abagnale, [[Bekarys]], and Karius, controls the Fledgling Night-Serpent Former apprentice of [[Clovis]], Champion of [[Aton]], wields [[The Wings of Vengeance]] and [[The Spear of Atonement]]. He hates [[Characters/Gods/Shao Daraan|Shao Daraan]] with all of his being, and will destroy the world and all of creation for revenge because Shao Daraan didn't create his daughter, father of Lisa, first champion of Kronos and betrayed him imprisoning him in the Red Pyramid to power his Timekeeper's Tower. Worked for [[Balthazaar]] to keep Pontius alive, Orchestrated the banishment of Tybalt, killed Takari (Melantha's dad Millais' lover), took life insurance policy to get Reister to find the Dawnheart, betrayed his follower [[Horus]], made [[Alabaster]] betray the Young Wolves during the fight against Tyran

Statblock: [Phase 1](obsidian://open?vault=Terra-Nova&file=statblocks%2Fkairos1.png), [Phase 2](obsidian://open?vault=Terra-Nova&file=statblocks%2Fkairos2.png)
